explanation: King Kong (1933) was brought to life with stop-motion models. Godzilla (1954) was an actor in a heavy rubber suit, and the two met in King Kong vs. Godzilla (1962).

claims.text: The original King Kong film was released in 1933.
The original Godzilla film was released in Japan in 1954.
King Kong (1933) brought its giant ape to life with stop-motion models.
In Godzilla (1954), the monster was played by an actor in a heavy rubber suit.
King Kong and Godzilla met in King Kong vs. Godzilla (1962).

writerNotes: Twenty-one years apart. Self-check 9.3. Lint: clean. Regional: a US film and a Japanese film, both known worldwide. Style: Oxford spelling, straight single quotes, plain hyphens, explanation of 30 words. Myths: claims screened against myths.json, no match. Mystery and encore: not applicable to a practice item. Doubts: none beyond the high-risk claims flagged for external evidence.
